validated.explanation: The pipeline infers a single transport event for green plate:1 between 43.1s and 45.0s (F0 to F2) with ~86px displacement (E0), during which a measured gripper opening occurred at 44.5s (E2, F1). The plate came to rest outside the target region for 31 consecutive rest observations from 45.0s to 46.0s (E1, F2-F3), consistent with being released outside the target. The deterministic pipeline verdict remains uncertain and the event status is inferred, not observed.

earliest_failure_interval.note: Inferred dropped_in_transport (released_outside_target) for green plate:1; gripper opening measured during move and rest outside target observed.

factual_claims.text: Track green plate:1 moved ~85.87px (0.5x its size) from rest at frame 1293 (43.1s, F0) to rest at frame 1350 (45.0s, F2).
Green plate:1 came to rest outside the target for 31 rest observations from frame 1350 to 1380 (45.0s to 46.033s, F2-F3).
Measured gripper opening occurred at frame 1335 (44.5s, F1), during or just after the move.
Gripper reading cannot show whether an object is held; joint data is used only for measured opening/closing.
Not every expected object has an established final position: 0/? green plates established inside.

hypotheses.text: The opening at 44.5s may correspond to an intentional release or an unintended drop, but the pipeline does not establish intent; release is inferred from opening together with coming to rest outside target.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis

visual_interpretations.text: F0 shows the red arm with gripper apparently over a green plate on the table near the dish rack. F1 shows a green plate in motion/blur near the rack edge while the gripper appears open. F2-F3 show a green plate at rest on the table outside the rack.
F1 appears to capture the plate mid-air during the transport, consistent with the inferred movement interval, but depth and contact are not verified by the pipeline.

limitations: Only 2D image positions are used; no depth (per event uncertainties).
A measured gripper opening is not by itself proof of a drop; release is inferred from opening together with coming to rest outside target and does not establish intent.
Gripper reading cannot show whether an object is held (E3).
Final placement inside target not established for green plates (E4).
Object ids from separate SAM requests are not assumed to be same physical instance across gaps.
